svg.text: The two coordinate arrays for all 9 lift grids
digits | L_orb (columns always CONSTANT, never Latin) | L_ph (columns always cycle; rows Latin only when the seed hits all 3 phases)
L_orb is constant down every column in all 9 — that is the lift. L_ph cycles down every column in all 9.
Only 159 and 168 have L_ph Latin, and those are exactly the two grids whose row sums are all 15.
